aggregate_semantics.mechanism: Reused the repository's existing full-parent-aggregate pattern (the same map-completeness-plus-per-member-execution shape already used for MD-S040's ten-member list and MD-S050-R0040's eight-fixture classification), not a new parallel mechanism. antiFutureMap() binds all nine items to their guards; test_the_anti_future_map_names_exactly_what_the_contract_names asserts the map and the contract sentence (parsed live, not transcribed) name exactly the same set, so an item silently dropped from the map or added to the contract with nothing behind it fails this test rather than leaving the parent quietly short.

aggregate_semantics.one_member_fails_others_stay_green: Demonstrated by all nine per-member probes above: each probe turned exactly its own target test red while the combined control suite across all four touched files (B18AntiFutureResolutionTest, B18AntiSurvivorshipFixtureCorpusTest, AsKnownReplayBoundaryTest, B18AsKnownSnapshotIsolationTest -- 28 tests, 175 assertions total) was confirmed green both before the probe series began and after every individual restore.
aggregate_semantics.known_limitation_not_probed: test_every_anti_future_guard_exists_and_is_executable performs a pure string search (strpos 'function <name>(') for each mapped guard, proving method existence, not behaviour. An attempt to falsifiability-probe this scaffold directly, by temporarily removing one entry from antiFutureMap() in B18AntiFutureResolutionTest.php, was blocked by the Claude Code auto-mode security classifier (reason: '[Security Test Removal]') before any test ran against the mutation; the file was immediately restored and confirmed sha256-identical to its pre-edit state, so no coverage was ever weakened. This limitation is structural (documented, not newly discovered) and does not affect this predicate's proof: the parent's actual falsifiability rests on the nine per-member production-code probes above, each of which independently proves its own guard is executing and load-bearing regardless of what this scaffold test itself can detect.
